say:2:1111515001:0.text: This stone tablet was left by Dura! Magister, Dura knew you would come!
say:2:1111515001:0.source_cn: 这竟然是女神艾雅留下的石碑！主人，艾雅大人早知道您会来！
say:2:1111515001:0.male: This stone tablet was left by Dura! Magister, Dura knew you would come!
say:2:1111515001:0.female: This stone tablet was left by Dura! Magister, Dura knew you would come!

say:3:1111515002:0.text: Now is not the time for joy. Things are much different than we thought... There is a Hypogean sealed in the Dusk Lord's tomb!
say:3:1111515002:0.source_cn: 现在可不是高兴的时候。这跟我们先前的猜测不一样，残阳神...

say:4:1111515003:0.text: Even worse, just as Dura feared, Illucia's actions in the Remnant Peaks have weakened the seal.
say:4:1111515003:0.source_cn: 更糟糕的是……正如艾雅大人担心的那样，由于伊露西卡在遗...

say:5:1111515004:0.text: It seems this is the root cause of the anomalies in the Crimson Highlands—the Hypogean's power is extending outward.
say:5:1111515004:0.source_cn: 看来，这才是深红高地出现异常的根本原因——恶魔的力量正...

say:9:1111515005:1.text: Does the inscription say that if we want to seal that horrid thing in again—that is, the Hypogean, we need to defeat it?
say:9:1111515005:1.source_cn: 这碑文是不是说，如果我们想要再次封印那东西……也就是…...

say:10:1111515006:1.text: Ah! I can't stand uttering such a filthy word!
say:10:1111515006:1.source_cn: 啊！受不了……真不想从我口中说出这么污秽的词语！

say:11:1111515007:0.text: My understanding is the same as yours. However, although the Hypogean's seal has been compromised, it is still in a contained state.
say:11:1111515007:0.source_cn: 我的理解和你一样。可是，虽然恶魔的封印出现了瑕疵，但它...

say:12:1111515008:0.text: We cannot defeat the Hypogean while it remains confined. Does that mean we need to...
say:12:1111515008:0.source_cn: 我们无法与被封印的恶魔战斗，如果想要与其一战，这不就意...

choice_prompt:13:1111515008.text: We cannot defeat the Hypogean while it remains confined. Does that mean we need to...
choice_prompt:13:1111515008.source_cn: 我们无法与被封印的恶魔战斗，如果想要与其一战，这不就意味着我们必须……

say:14:1111515009:0.text: Wait! Unseal that... thing?! Can we really do this?
say:14:1111515009:0.source_cn: 等等！要解开那东西的封印？现在？这么做能行吗……

say:15:1111515010:0.text: The magister knows the magical process of sealing a Hypogean. To release it, the method is simply reversed.
say:15:1111515010:0.source_cn: 主人掌握着封印恶魔的魔法术式，想要解除封印的话，只需将...
say:15:1111515010:0.male: The magister knows the magical process of sealing a Hypogean. To release it, the method is simply reversed.
say:15:1111515010:0.female: The magister knows the magical process of sealing a Hypogean. To release it, the method is simply reversed.

say:16:1111515011:0.text: For a great mage like the magister, this should be a small task.
say:16:1111515011:0.source_cn: 对于主人这样伟大的魔法师来说，不是什么难事。
say:16:1111515011:0.male: For a great mage like the magister, this should be a small task.
say:16:1111515011:0.female: For a great mage like the magister, this should be a small task.

say:17:1111515012:0.text: That's not what I mean... we're discussing the release of a malevolent Hypogean! Shouldn't we be cautious?
say:17:1111515012:0.source_cn: 我不是担心这个……我的意思是，那可是恶魔啊！不该慎之又慎吗？

say:18:1111515013:0.text: At least let me perform a divination on the probability of our success...
say:18:1111515013:0.source_cn: 起码先让我对获胜的概率做个占卜……

say:19:1111515014:0.text: I agree with Satrana. We need to be careful with how we proceed.
say:19:1111515014:0.source_cn: 我赞同萨忒娜的观点，谨慎为好。

say:20:1111515015:0.text: Even if we truly can lift the seal, there's no guarantee we'll defeat the Hypogean. The results of failure would be catastrophic.
say:20:1111515015:0.source_cn: 就算我们能解除恶魔的封印，可是没人能保证，我们一定可以...

say:21:1111515016:0.text: However, since the seal has already been compromised, it's only a matter of time before it shatters.
say:21:1111515016:0.source_cn: 不过，封印既然已经出现了裂痕，迟早会彻底破损。

say:22:1111515017:0.text: The Crimson Highlands and all the surrounding areas will...
say:22:1111515017:0.source_cn: 更别说在那之前，整个深红高原，乃至周边恐怕都……

say:25:1111515018:0.text: What will happen?! Finish your words!
say:25:1111515018:0.source_cn: 都会怎样？安丹姐！你把话说完啊！

say:26:1111515019:0.text: Koko, if we don't fight the Hypogean, your homeland will be destroyed long before the seal is fully broken.
say:26:1111515019:0.source_cn: 卡卡，如果我们不与恶魔战斗，恐怕在他的封印彻底破溃前，...

say:27:1111515020:0.text: Then I'll fight! I'm not afraid of pain, only of losing my home!
say:27:1111515020:0.source_cn: 卡卡要战斗！卡卡不怕受伤，卡卡害怕失去家园！

say:32:1111515021:0.text: Magister Merlin, what should we do?
say:32:1111515021:0.male: Magister Merlin, what should we do?
say:32:1111515021:0.female: Magister Merlin, what should we do?

choice_prompt:33:1111515021.text: Magister Merlin, what should we do?
choice_prompt:33:1111515021.male: Magister Merlin, what should we do?
choice_prompt:33:1111515021.female: Magister Merlin, what should we do?

say:36:1111515022:0.source_cn: 你应该知道我会怎么选。

say:37:1111515023:0.text: I've come this far, and I won't back down.
say:37:1111515023:0.source_cn: 已经走到这里了，我决不退缩。
say:37:1111515023:0.male: I've come this far, and I won't back down.
say:37:1111515023:0.female: I've come this far, and I won't back down.

say:41:1111515026:0.text: Magister, as Dura said in the inscription, it's time for you and your companions to take a stand!
say:41:1111515026:0.source_cn: 主人，就像女神艾雅在碑文里提到的那样，该您和同伴们出场了！
say:41:1111515026:0.male: Magister, as Dura said in the inscription, it's time for you and your companions to take a stand!
say:41:1111515026:0.female: Magister, as Dura said in the inscription, it's time for you and your companions to take a stand!

say:42:1111515027:1.text: And Chippy is always ready to charge ahead for you!
say:42:1111515027:1.source_cn: 满满永远愿意为您冲锋在前！
say:42:1111515027:1.male: And Chippy is always ready to charge ahead for you!
say:42:1111515027:1.female: And Chippy is always ready to charge ahead for you!

say:45:1111515028:1.text: Don't hog the spotlight, Chippy. Merlin also has me by his side.
say:45:1111515028:1.source_cn: 不要一个人抢功劳啊，满满。梅林身边还有我呢。

say:45:1111515028:1.female: Don't hog the spotlight, Chippy. Merlin also has me by her side.

say:46:1111515029:1.text: And not just me, but all of us who have come this far.
say:46:1111515029:1.source_cn: 不止是我，还有一路走来的各位。
say:46:1111515029:1.male: And not just me, but all of us who have come this far.
say:46:1111515029:1.female: And not just me, but all of us who have come this far.

say:47:1111515030:1.text: Merlin, have you made up your mind?
say:47:1111515030:1.source_cn: 梅林，你是不是已经下定决心了？
say:47:1111515030:1.male: Merlin, have you made up your mind?
say:47:1111515030:1.female: Merlin, have you made up your mind?

choice_prompt:48:1111515030.male: Merlin, have you made up your mind?
choice_prompt:48:1111515030.female: Merlin, have you made up your mind?

say:50:1111515032:1.text: Let's not delay! Time to unseal the Hypogean!
say:50:1111515032:1.source_cn: 事不宜迟，我们去解开那恶魔的封印吧！

say:54:1111515024:0.source_cn: 不行……我试过了，这里的气息会干扰我，我无法做出准确的占卜。
say:54:1111515024:0.male: I can't... the aura here is in flux, preventing any method of divination.
say:54:1111515024:0.female: I can't... the aura here is in flux, preventing any method of divination.
